# Pins the SimChecksum (v8) sequence for WorkerCastCrystalCostScenario.Build() (one gathering P1 worker casts a Self ability costing energy+ore+crystal via a CastAbility UnitOrder at tick 1; Player2 empty so the AI no-ops) stepped via StepOnce at ChecksumInterval=1.
